channel.name: ext-acme-corp
channel.purpose: External channel with Acme Corp team

messages.text: Hey Sarah, quick heads up - Lisa (our CFO) is joining the Q1 review call on Friday. She's going to want to see the ROI numbers we discussed.
Thanks for the heads up John! I'll make sure to have the updated ROI projections ready. Should I send them over beforehand so she can review?
That would be great. If you can get them to me by Thursday EOD, I can forward to her with some context.
Also - any update on the implementation timeline? We're really trying to hit that Q2 go-live.
Checking with our delivery team today. Initial estimate is 8-10 weeks from contract signing. I'll confirm and include in the ROI deck.
Hey Tom - one question on the API docs you sent. Is the data residency guaranteed to be US-only? We have some compliance requirements.
Yes, confirmed - all data will reside in our US-East region (AWS us-east-1). We can add this explicitly to the contract if that helps.
:+1: That works. I'll let legal know.
FYI - TechRival came back with a lower quote. I want to go with you guys but I need to justify the price difference to Lisa. Can you help me build that case?

Absolutely. I'll put together a TCO comparison showing the full picture over 3 years. Our integration typically saves 40+ hours/month vs point solutions, plus our support SLA is 2 hours vs their 24-48.
Perfect. If you can get that to me before the Q1 review, I can share it with Lisa beforehand. That should help.

Great meeting today everyone! Sending over the revised proposal (v3) with the updated payment terms we discussed. Key changes:
• Payment terms: Net 30 (changed from Net 15)
• Added 99.9% SLA guarantee
• Included 24/7 support tier
Got it, thanks Sarah. I'll review with Mike and get back to you by EOW.

pending_items: Send ROI projections by Thursday EOD
